title: WorkflowStatus
description: Status the Task Orchestrator publishes to its status endpoint. Acceptance/rejection and ongoing progress of a workflow run are both reported here.

run_id.description: The workflow run this status is about.

workflow_id.description: The workflow definition this run was started from.

state.description: Current state of the run. `REJECTED` reports a command that could not be accepted.

current_task_id.description: task_id of the task currently executing, when running.

completed_task_ids.description: task_ids of the tasks completed so far in this run.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 time this status was produced.

error.description: Failure or rejection reason. Present for failed/rejected states.
